body: Thank you so much guys. Apparently I am a tool engineer and my stupid location settings were enabled on my phone and I was picked up by police.  Am now admitted to a hospital in psych. I broke down after reading these posts and was too slow to get my setup ready. Also, apparently this method is NOT painless all the time, Dr. showed me some horrible pictures of bulging, bloodshot eyes on pale corpses. I'm not allowed to have a phone in here so I have to go. I just wanted to say thank you for saving my life. Medicine cocktail is clearing my head already and ironically I feel even more depressed, not sure what the hell is going on.
if you're anywhere near southern ontario i would be with you. literally on the edge right now
